\label{sec:transport-equation-nonhomogeneous-problem}

For
$$(4)\qquad
\begin{cases}
u_t+b\cdot Du=f&\text{in }\R^n\times(0,\infty),\\
u=g&\text{on }\R^n\times\{t=0\},
\end{cases}$$
integration along characteristics gives the following formula.
